name: Thera Work
summary:
Thera Work is a Therafy module that prepares teens above 13 and adults for the workplace through job interview simulations in virtual reality with Artificial Intelligence.

In a realistic setting, users take part in an interview with a virtual interviewer and experience, in a safe and controlled way, one of the most anxiety-inducing social situations of adult life.
